baseline.note: Pre-refactor measurement on the pre-T1.6 code: mean per-query recall@10 = 1.0 (all 12 queries retrieve all expected docs). Do NOT update this number to make a failing test pass — a drop below baseline - epsilon means the refactor degraded recall and must be fixed, not re-baselined. Re-baseline only when the retrieval algorithm intentionally changes (then record the reason here).
